title: Running Sum of 1d Array
description:
You are given an integer array nums.

Definition

The running sum at index i is defined as:

runningSum[i] = nums[0] + nums[1] + ... + nums[i]
Task

Return an array runningSum where each element represents the cumulative sum up to that index.

Examples

Example 1
Input: nums = [1,2,3,4]
Output: [1,3,6,10]

Example 2
Input: nums = [1,1,1,1,1]
Output: [1,2,3,4,5]

Example 3
Input: nums = [3,1,2,10,1]
Output: [3,4,6,16,17]

Constraints
1 ≤ nums.length ≤ 1000
-10⁶ ≤ nums[i] ≤ 10⁶
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
